prompt: Objective: cut a university's lab supply costs. What you've learned: lab supply costs rose 16% with research activity flat. Latest finding: prices paid for the top 30 items are 12% above negotiated contract prices. What is the best next step?

options.text: Benchmark the university's contract prices against other universities
options.feedback: Secondary: the university isn't even paying its own contract prices.

options.text: Find out why purchases are made off-contract so often
options.feedback: Right. The gap between paid and contract prices is the lever; why it happens is next.

options.text: Work out the savings from switching to a new supplier
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix when the problem is buying off-contract.

explanation: The top 30 items cost 12% above contract. Find out why purchases are off-contract and what fixing it is worth.
